title: Chapter 50 — The Warm Path: Mining Your Existing Book
intro: The fastest accounts come from relationships you already have — the bridge call and referral engine.

sections.title: Mine Before You Prospect
sections.content:
Before cold calling builders you have never met, mine the relationships you already have. Your retail customers include homeowners who hired contractors, designers, and builders. Your existing trade accounts know other trade professionals. Your delivery team sees other vendors' products on job sites.

The bridge call: 'Hi [customer name], I hope you are still loving the kitchen. Quick question — who was your contractor on that project? I would love to connect with them about our trade program.'

This call has a conversion rate 5-10 times higher than a cold call because it comes with a warm introduction. The contractor hears 'your client recommended me' — that is social proof plus a satisfied customer reference in one sentence.

sections.title: The Referral Ask for Trade
sections.content:
Every delivered trade project is a referral opportunity. After a successful delivery to a builder's job site: 'The project turned out great. Do you know any other builders or designers who might benefit from working with us? I would love an introduction.'

Every designer you work with knows builders. Every builder knows other builders. One introduction from a trusted source is worth 50 cold calls because trust transfers through relationships.

Track every referral source in CRM. When a builder refers another builder, note it. This tells you which relationships are producing referrals and which need more nurturing. The accounts that refer are your most valuable accounts — invest proportionally.

sections.title: The Existing Book Audit
sections.content:
Pull your delivered customer list from the last 24 months. For every customer who did a renovation or new build, ask: who was their contractor? Their designer? Their builder? You may already have 10-20 warm introductions sitting in your CRM that you have never made.

This audit is a one-time exercise that can fill your trade pipeline for months. The leads are warm, the introductions are credible, and the conversion rate is dramatically higher than cold prospecting.
